evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

CA.rationale: Content (red coordinate) and a processing/origin condition (command_estimate) are both present for the same candidate/time.

COD.rationale: The same current referent has an identified content (red coordinates), an explicit organization/pattern (coordinate cluster and grid orientation), and a separate origin/status field.

A.rationale: A processing/origin condition (command_estimate) is explicitly linked to the same candidate content (see matching red coordinate line).

C.rationale: Multiple lines identify represented contents (color-labeled coordinate sets) and their attributes.

D.rationale: Origins/status fields are recorded separately from the content coordinate entries for the same referents.

O.rationale: The report specifies how contents are presented/organized (grid orientation and grouped coordinate clusters).
